PreToolUse.command: if cat "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'ALTER\\s+TABLE|DROP\\s+TABLE|CREATE\\s+TABLE'; then echo '[BLOCKED] DDL statement detected — database schema changes are forbidden'; exit 2; fi

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -q '__tests__'; then cd TOT_backend/server && npx jest "$FILE_PATH" --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
PostToolUse.description: Auto-run Jest on edited test files
